turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Thank you for seeing me, Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll keep this short. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of your class. Who decided on that mark, and on what basis?
Don't thank me yet. You haven't answered my question. Who entered that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before they did?
The file was created at 11:31 PM. 612 words appeared at 11:52 PM and 794 more at 11:58 PM.
I'm writing that down exactly as you said it: 11:31 PM, 612 words at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. Where do those times come from, and who has seen them besides you?
How long after the file was created did the first words appear?

I'm not doing your arithmetic for you, Hale. You gave me the times, and you can work out the gap yourself. What I want to know is whether Owen was asked about any of this before my son's name went into your gradebook.
What time is it now, by the way?
It's 4:21. I have nineteen minutes before my call, so you can answer my question now.
